food_quality_note: Prefer Foundation results first because they are usually less processed and more nutrient-accurate; use SR Legacy only as a fallback when Foundation has no results.

1278.name: PUFA 20:5 n-3 (EPA), current USDA Foundation id

1272.name: PUFA 22:6 n-3 (DHA), current USDA Foundation id

1280.name: PUFA 22:5 n-3 (DPA), current USDA Foundation id included for practical total omega-3 estimate

field_mapping.name: description
field_mapping.serving_size_g: servingSize when servingSizeUnit is g; default 100g
field_mapping.metadata_jsonb: full raw USDA search result object plus ingestion quality flags

data_quality_rules.missing_nutrient: default nutrient column to 0.0 and preserve raw result in metadata_jsonb
data_quality_rules.no_results: log [DATA ISSUE: no results for {term}] and continue
data_quality_rules.single_food_failure: log error and continue next food
data_quality_rules.data_type_priority: search Foundation first, then SR Legacy fallback to avoid processed matches for simple foods

unmapped_usda_fields.foodNutrients: only selected nutrient IDs are normalized to columns; full list remains in metadata_jsonb
unmapped_usda_fields.foodMeasures: preserved in metadata_jsonb; V1 does not normalize household measures
unmapped_usda_fields.score: USDA search relevance only; preserved in metadata_jsonb, not used in nutrition scoring
unmapped_usda_fields.additionalDescriptions: preserved in metadata_jsonb for search/debug context
